fields.name: Shard Addressing
fields.responsibility: Exposes one named shard of a set as its own read and write endpoint pair and runs a query against that single shard instead of fanning out — the path a caller takes when it already knows which shard holds the record, typically from a shard key it is carrying. It offers the same data-method families as a non-sharded endpoint, plus the forms that return shard keys rather than bare record ids.
